bootstrap.sampling: sample eligible athlete IDs with replacement; retain all pitches and sampled multiplicity; use identical draws for paired models

inclusion.population: all checksum-verified joined pitches from the pinned source
inclusion.target_missingness: omit only rows with missing or nonfinite observed outcome separately by target; report exclusions; never fill targets from metadata
inclusion.feature_missingness: training-fold median imputation with missingness indicators; standardization fitted in training fold only
inclusion.target_priority: neither target has priority; report both

interpretation.study_type: exploratory follow-on using the already viewed Phase1 cohort; not preregistered or independent confirmatory evidence
interpretation.prediction_scope: retrospective completed-pitch associations for held-out athletes in the same source setting
interpretation.uncertainty_scope: conditional on fixed out-of-fold predictions and the observed source cohort; excludes model-refitting and full training-set uncertainty
interpretation.partition_sensitivity: refit all training pipelines for each seed; ten partitions are overlapping descriptive sensitivity analyses, not independent experiments or confidence intervals
interpretation.multiple_comparisons: no p-values, formal significance threshold, multiplicity-adjusted confirmation, or selection of a winning outcome
